exact_missing_items: Completion state progression must follow: Locally Complete → Available to Seam → Seam Complete; each transition has defined gates
All blocked states must expose: reason, owner, time blocked, and next step — these 4 fields are mandatory in every blocked-state display
Action-gating under stale projections: execution/promotion/recovery/approval actions require fresh-enough projection; the UI must explain gating inline, not silently block
Alert levels must be exactly: Info, Warning, Attention, Action Required — this is a closed four-level taxonomy
Alert state semantics: 'resolved' means the underlying condition changed; 'dismissed' means presentation hidden only; blockers must NOT be dismissible
These three states are not synonyms and must not be conflated in any doc
Acknowledgement model: 'acknowledged' ≠ 'resolved' ≠ 'dismissed'; acknowledgement is for advisory/non-blocking concerns only; blockers are not acknowledgeable
Settings groupings must be: Providers & Models, Execution Identity, Governance, Workers, Recovery, HITL — these are the canonical top-level settings categories
GUI help/tooltip generation requires: stable canonical terminology, clear object vs state vs action distinctions, and enough 'why this exists' language to support Simple/Expert/ELI5 derivation
Alert surface split: Dashboard shows summary/urgency only; Orchestrator shows detailed operational alerts; chat shows only Action Required alerts
